A key followed by "="; trailing whitespace must be consumed by the
entry-boundary skip before the full-consumption check.

source:
## Semantics: S1, S5, T1, C3, M0, A1
grammar ConformanceTrailingTrivia version "1.0.0" mode "v1" {
  ## Whitespace trivia.
  trivia = 1*" "
  ## A key followed by "="; trailing whitespace must be consumed by the
  ## entry-boundary skip before the full-consumption check.
  main = 1*%x61-7A "="

  skip = trivia

  entry main: main

  test main {
    accept "a="
    accept "a=   "
    accept "  a =  "
    reject "a= !"
  }
}
